participantActionRequired.description: Obtain Oregon State Police LEDS criminal history. Use the Oregon State Police set-aside criminal history request and instructions, retained in Edition 1.2, or the Oregon Judicial Department request for a set-aside criminal record check. The LEDS history fixes the offence class, the disposition and the sentence-completion dates, and it is obtained before anything is drafted.

Check your answer to "What was the offence called, which ORS section was cited, and on what date did it happen?" against Oregon State Police LEDS criminal history, and correct the packet if they disagree.
Obtain Circuit court record showing the disposition and its date. Ask the circuit court clerk for the docket and the judgment or order showing how the case ended and when.
participantActionRequired.obtainedFrom: The circuit court that handled the case

participantActionRequired.description: Check your answer to "What was the offence called, which ORS section was cited, and on what date did it happen?" against Circuit court record showing the disposition and its date, and correct the packet if they disagree.
Obtain A full set of fingerprints. Have a full set of fingerprints taken and forward them to the Department of State Police with its record-check fee. ORS 137.225(2)(c) and (2)(d).

No court filing fee under ORS 137.225(1)(g). The Department of State Police charges a record-check fee not exceeding actual cost, once per person where only one check is performed regardless of the number of counties. The prosecuting attorney may not charge a fee.
